Name: PearStar's Marriage Candidates Portraits
Author: Pearstar37
Description:
[b][u]This mod requires Portraiture!!
[/u][/b]How to install: 
[list]
[*]download Portraiture if you haven't.
[*]download this mod, it should be a folder named ﻿[b]PearStar's Marriage Candidates Portraits[/b]
[*]place the folder inside Portraiture>Portraits folder.
[*]if the portraits are not showing in the game, it's probably because you are currently using another portrait mod, try press P when dialogue box is open to switch between portrait mods. 
[/list]
Hi, this is PearStar! If you like the style of this mod please stay tuned, I am working on the marriage candidates's winter costume & all villagers portraits. You can support me on afdian: ﻿[url=https://afdian.net/a/pearstar37]https://afdian.net/a/pearstar37[/url]﻿
